name: a small portfolio glitches into its next state
looks: A short row of small numbered cards shows which products are live and which are coming soon, under a headline naming the count. The whole row suddenly glitches -- channels split apart and tear sideways for a couple of frames -- before snapping back to show one more card now live and the labels updated.
build: DOM/canvas small fixed-card row (numbered, each with a live/waitlist tag); on the update beat the frame's RGB channels are drawn offset with a few horizontal bands torn out of alignment for 2-4 frames (seeded jitter, re-rolled, not tweened), then everything snaps back aligned with the row's new state.
sound: A harsh short digital stutter exactly on the glitch frames, cutting off sharply as the row resolves.
prompt: Show a small, growing portfolio as a short row of numbered status cards, then punctuate an update to that row with one sharp, short glitch -- channels splitting and tearing for a couple of frames -- before it snaps back clean with the new state in place. Use the glitch as punctuation for 'this just changed,' not as a stylistic filter.
